description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Choose `mode` (flayr, domain or mailbox), the display `fromName`, `replyTo`, `repliesTo` (brand or flayr) and `fromLocalPart` (before the @ on the brand domain). domain needs brand_sending_domain_add first; mailbox needs a connected mailbox. An empty string clears fromName or replyTo.
(Wraps PUT /api/v2/brands/{id}/sending-identity.)

fromLocalPart.description: The part before the @ on the brand domain (default hello).

id.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. A brand-bound key may only name its own brand (another brand → 403).

name: brand_sending_identity_set
title: Set a brand's sending identity
